title: Code and derived data for: Colonisation-extinction imbalance reveals a demographic trap in Iberian steppe birds
description: Analysis code (R) and derived detection-history matrices for dynamic occupancy models of four steppe bird species (Otis tarda, Tetrax tetrax, Pterocles alchata, Pterocles orientalis) in mainland Spain, 2017-2023, fitted to eBird data corrected for imperfect detection. Raw eBird records are not redistributed; they are available from eBird (https://ebird.org) under the eBird Basic Dataset terms of use.
